object_interaction_kinematics.description: Robot-object retargeting kinematic quality on OMOMO from Table II. Penetration and foot skating are constraints; contact preservation is the interaction benefit.

penetration_duration.description: Fraction of scored frames with robot body penetration into terrain or carried object.

max_penetration_cm.description: Worst penetration depth in centimeters across scored frames.

foot_skating_duration.description: Fraction of source stance-foot events where the retargeted foot slips.

max_foot_skating_cm_s.description: Maximum retargeted stance-foot slip speed in centimeters per second.

contact_preservation.description: Fraction of desired object-contact events preserved within tolerance.

pelvis_path_error_cm.description: Mean pelvis displacement-path error in centimeters after aligning the initial pelvis position.

motion_velocity_error_cm_s.description: Mean keypoint velocity mismatch to the source motion in centimeters per second.

terrain_interaction_kinematics.description: Robot-terrain retargeting kinematic quality on in-house MoCap from Table II. Contact preservation must improve while maintaining hard constraints.

penetration_duration.description: Fraction of scored frames with robot body penetration into terrain.

max_penetration_cm.description: Worst terrain penetration depth in centimeters across scored frames.

foot_skating_duration.description: Fraction of source stance-foot events where the retargeted foot slips.

max_foot_skating_cm_s.description: Maximum retargeted stance-foot slip speed in centimeters per second.

contact_preservation.description: Fraction of desired hand-terrain contact events preserved within tolerance.

pelvis_path_error_cm.description: Mean pelvis displacement-path error in centimeters after aligning the initial pelvis position.

motion_velocity_error_cm_s.description: Mean keypoint velocity mismatch to the source motion in centimeters per second.
